arguments.reply: ₹1,500 tak trekking shoes nahi mile; yeh casual, running aur formal alternatives hain, jinmein meri pick MonsoonGrip Terra Casual Sneakers hai kyunki yeh waterproof hai aur rubber sole hai. Yeh women’s model hai; Footcraft Classic Formal Shoes unisex hai, par waterproof nahi.

cases.description: No microwave is under ₹5,500; raising the budget by 15% (to ₹6,325) finds one.

turns.user: Is there any microwave for under ₹5,500?
turns.reply: There isn’t a microwave under ₹5,500 in the store; the Tava Turbo Microwave costs ₹6,199. If you can stretch your budget, it’s my pick for its 5-year warranty.

cases.description: No 16 GB phone is under ₹36,000; raising the budget by 15% (to ₹41,400) finds some.

turns.user: Need a phone with 16GB RAM, budget ₹36,000
turns.reply: No 16 GB RAM phones met your ₹36,000 budget; these options cost more. My pick is Kirin Orbit Phone (16 GB RAM, 512 GB) because it’s the cheapest of these at ₹40,329.
